candidate_relations.reason: Although hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia can cause telangiectasias and intrapulmonary shunting, it does not capture the TEMPI composite of telangiectasias, elevated erythropoietin with erythrocytosis, monoclonal gammopathy, perinephric fluid collections, and intrapulmonary shunting.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Alternative hereditary telangiectasia disorder rather than TEMPI syndrome.
